core_obligations: Forward direction (proof lines 966-971): assume Gamma |- A; the extended set derives A (monotonicity), derives not A (reflexivity), and the axiom chain not A |- A -> falsum with two modus ponens yields Gamma + {not A} |- falsum.
Converse (lines 973-979): assume Gamma + {not A} |- falsum; the deduction theorem gives Gamma |- not A -> falsum; ax:lfalse2 and mp give Gamma |- not-not A; ax:dne and mp conclude Gamma |- A.
proof_roadmap: Extend the assumptions by the negation and derive both A and not A.
Collapse them to falsum through the negation axiom.
For the converse, discharge not A by the deduction theorem and cancel the double negation.
difficulty_reason: Characterises provability through inconsistent extensions (statement 961-964, proof 966-981): both directions are spelled out line by line; the forward half chains two same-part structural propositions and two axioms, the converse leans on the deduction theorem and classical double-negation elimination. H2: multi-citation assembly, each citation made explicit in the text.
